sources.reason: user-provided-spec: hand-authored internal YAML from completed measured discovery. Evidence that browser-sniff would add nothing: (1) every content URL returns HTTP 200 via plain Go net/http, ~60 probes, zero Cloudflare, no auth, so there is no clearance or challenge to capture; (2) the release index is a JS literal INSIDE the served HTML (const data + cpidata1), independently re-verified by me in the 340,726-byte body: 211 'annexure' occurrences, 141 .xlsx, 379 .pdf — it is not fetched by XHR; (3) the data payloads are static .xlsx and text-layer .pdf files at direct URLs. There is no JSON/XHR data API to discover. The only JSON surface found (wp-json/wp/v2/posts, x-wp-total 17) serves WordPress announcement posts, not price data.
